subject.title: Multi-profile profile targeting/config truth is ambiguous with ~/.openclaw-* homes on macOS

question: What should the macOS profile-targeting contract be when explicit root `--profile` conflicts with inherited launchd identity, profile casing, or separate `~/.openclaw-*` homes?
rationale: The stale-label subcase is source-backed, but choosing precedence and normalization semantics changes supported operator behavior for existing macOS service installs.

options.title: Make explicit profile authoritative
options.body: Treat root `--profile` as the service, config, and session target, clear only stale OpenClaw-managed inherited labels, and add clearer status output plus live proof.

options.title: Preserve label override precedence
options.body: Keep `OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_LABEL` stronger than `--profile` and document cross-profile lifecycle commands as unsupported when inherited env state conflicts.

options.title: Defer broader profile design
options.body: Keep this issue as a design umbrella until maintainers decide casing, mixed-home, service-label, and config/load truth semantics together.

recommendation.title: Make explicit profile authoritative
recommendation.body: Treat root `--profile` as the service, config, and session target, clear only stale OpenClaw-managed inherited labels, and add clearer status output plus live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across profile-aware service names, launchd override-label behavior, macOS gateway lifecycle, and multi-gateway docs.
